definition_lines: Semantic field: a group of words connected by a shared idea or concept.
templates: By constructing a semantic field of [idea] with the terms '[word 1]', '[word 2]' and '[word 3]', (author) underscores ..., positioning ...
examples: By constructing a semantic field of destruction with the terms ‘'damaged', 'shattered' and 'broken', Wargan cumulatively underscores the ominous repercussions of retail crime, positioning local shoppers to reject passive bystanding.
